format: table[local_experts][num_tokens] = [tile_N, config] for FlashInfer's trtllm-gen NVFP4 routed MoE (Muse Spark expert shape)
entries_32_to_256: chosen with bench/bench_moe_tactics.py: a screen of every candidate tactic, then an interleaved confirmation on routing captured from a served benchmark run (synthetic acceptance); kept only if faster than the fallback there and no slower (within 1 %) on uniform random routing
entries_8_to_24: chosen with bench/bench_moe_tactics.py --candidates-only at 8, 16 and 24 tokens: the fastest bitwise candidate on captured routing that is also within 1 % of the fallback on uniform random routing (each within run-to-run spread of the fallback or faster), so the choice at these sizes no longer depends on a per-node autotune cache
outputs: every entry gave expert outputs bitwise identical to the default tactic (tests/test_moe_tactic.py --gpu)
